Havoc Demon Hunter Rotation in 

Havoc Demon Hunter follows a priority list due to high-value cooldowns, while juggling Fury as a resource to spend as available. The core concepts to keep in mind in single target are these:

 

 

 
 Avoid Fury Waste: In Single Target, Fury is our primary resource used for spending on Chaos Strike , while maintaining enough Fury to cast Blade Dance when it comes off cooldown.
 

 

 
 

 
 Keep Abilities on Cooldown: Cast abilities such as Blade Dance , Immolation Aura , and Eye Beam on cooldown, while spending Fury during downtime. 
 

 

 
 

 
 Line Up Medium Cooldowns: Essence Break lines up to every second Eye Beam , Vengeful Retreat for Inertia and Initiative lines up with every Eye Beam .

 Aldrachi Reaver Notes

Pre-Combat Check

Havoc Demon Hunter has no spec specific pre-combat steps to take due to our raid buff applying on attacking a mob. So I will simply list your consumables check!

 Havoc Demon Hunter Major Cooldowns

For Havoc Demon Hunter, their cooldowns all interact with one another and have some specific utilization and ordering to use correctly as talked about below.

 Metamorphosis is not simply a press and go button due to the talent Chaotic Transformation , which resets the cooldown of Eye Beam and Death Sweep . This means that a large portion of your burst damage will happen before Metamorphosis is cast, making it extremely bad to macro trinkets directly into Meta. This also gives you a specific rotation to setup before casting, as the openers show.

Due to Demonic , Eye Beam provides a burst window where you are temporarily in Demon Form to make use of Annihilation and Death Sweep . This typically means preparing before the window to get Inertia and Initiative , up as well as using Essence Break (if talented) after, to stack all the damage amplification effects possible.

 Essence Break is cast when already in Metamorphosis form, whether from the cooldown cast or Demonic proccing from Eye Beam as the extra haste will allow for an extra GCD in the window. As Essence Break does a flat damage amount and works on AoE through Death Sweep, you will always use it after Eye Beam to double Death Sweep in AoE.

 The Hunt usage depends on your Hero Talent, for Fel-Scarred there is no talent interaction with your kit and it is simply pressed on cooldown for the damage it deals. Aldrachi Reaver has an important interaction with The Hunt, after the cast succeeds it will generate a Reaver's Glaive if you do not already have one. This means you must ALWAYS use a generated Reaver's Glaive in hand before casting The Hunt when it comes up, however you still will be looking to cast The Hunt on cooldown. The one caveat is due to Eternal Hunt only lasting 12 seconds, you should wait for Eye Beam to be up within 10 seconds before casting.

 Havoc Demon Hunter Advanced Tips

 
 Inertia 

 With Inertia , you will be lining up Vengeful Retreat consistently to Eye Beam . This is due to Tactical Retreat and Cycle of Hatred reducing both abilities to a 20 second cooldown, while using the damage amplification with the burst around Eye Beam for Fel-Scarred. If you make a mistake and de-sync, continue to use Eye Beam on cooldown and hold Vengeful Retreat for your next Eye Beam.
